# Oh My Pi RPC 18.8.3 identity

Secret-free identity and per-hop source/tree ledger for `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent` from the qualified `18.2.7` ceiling through current official stable `18.8.3`. The full npm package inventory records every path and SHA-256 for the baseline plus all 32 published hops. The hop ledger recomputes complete added/removed/changed path sets and classifies every selected wire, lifecycle, failure, permission, usage, configuration, or tool source change.

The published npm tarball is authoritative because `gitHead` is null. GitHub tags and changed selected source files are corroboration only after their content hashes match the exact npm tree. `18.2.9` is published on npm without a GitHub tag and is read from its verified tarball. GitHub-only tags `18.0.2`, `18.1.7`, `18.4.7`, and `18.6.2` remain excluded. The previous deprecated `17.x` segment and exact RPC controls are unchanged.

The only tool names selected remain `read`, `grep`, `glob`, `todo`, and `ask`; the 14 selected RPC commands are unchanged. Newer RPC commands remain unselected. Provider-internal `cfg://`, `proc://`, `attachment://`, and `conflict://` resources use the existing ambient `read` tool; credentials are redacted and RPC write paths are not selected.

No artifact was executed. No provider prompt, login, live catalogue/session, installation, credential use, or host update occurred.
